justification: Both present a single frontal humanoid figure filling a tall stone block, with a broad ornamented headdress at the top and a prominent circular disc on the chest, so the basic vertical head-over-body scheme corresponds. The rendering, however, is wholly different: A is a thin flat slab with crisp, dense, fine-line relief including framing glyph-like blocks, while B is a massive rounded boulder with sparse, shallow, heavily eroded incision and no comparable framing register.
